nowLine: now:'v13.45: TAB PAUSES AND BACKS OUT, THE WAY ESCAPE DOES. TAB now does everything Escape does, which matters on itch, where the browser spends Escape on leaving fullscreen. - Raid: TAB closes the map before the backpack, closes the emote bar and the stall, pauses with nothing open, and closes the pause box. - Undercroft: TAB closes the top window, the item menu, the edit box, the floor backpack and the stash panel, and pauses with nothing open. - Title: TAB never pauses. - Escape behaves exactly as before. - TAB no longer opens the backpack; I does. - B still backs out and still gives orders in this build. - A controller player notices nothing: View still opens the backpack, because it now taps I. - Key lists, the pause line, the title line, the HUD hint and the what-is-new card say I for the backpack and TAB for pause and back.',

edits.old: 'PRESS B TO BACK OUT OF ANY MENU. It closes whatever is in front, one thing per press, in the Undercroft and on the surface. With nothing open it still gives your hire his orders, and it never opens the pause box.',
edits.new: 'PRESS B TO BACK OUT OF ANY MENU, OR TAB, WHICH ALSO PAUSES. Either closes whatever is in front, one thing per press, in the Undercroft and on the surface. On itch the browser spends Escape on leaving fullscreen, so TAB now does everything Escape does in the game: with nothing open it pauses, and it closes the pause box again. B with nothing open still gives your hire his orders. The backpack is on I.',

edits.old: Only P and ESC answer while it is up, which are the two keys it names.',
edits.new: Only P, TAB and ESC answer while it is up.',

edits.old: and the full-pack message names Z, which drops, not TAB, which opens it.',
edits.new: and the full-pack message names Z, which drops, not the key that opens it.',

edits.old: 'A BELT KEY TELLS YOU THE RIGHT KEY. Pressing a tactical belt key for a gun still in your backpack used to say "TAB to equip it"; TAB only opens the backpack. It now says TAB, then ENTER, which is what equips it.',
F is your melee strike, TAB is the backpack, 1 to 9 is the tactical belt.',
edits.new: F is your melee strike, I opens the backpack, 1 to 9 is the tactical belt.',

edits.old: 1-9 tactical belt   TAB backpack   ENTER equip from backpack   M map   H controls   P / ESC pause
edits.new: 1-9 tactical belt   I backpack   ENTER equip from backpack   M map   H controls   TAB back out   P / TAB pause
